record.bible_text: The words<WH01697> of the Preacher<WH06953>, the son<WH01121> of David<WH01732>, king<WH04428> in Jerusalem<WH03389>.
Vanity<WH01892> of vanities<WH01892>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Preacher<WH06953>, vanity<WH01892> of vanities<WH01892>; all <FI>is<Fi> vanity<WH01892>.
What profit<WH03504> hath a man<WH0120> of all his labour<WH05999> which he taketh<WH05998><WTH8799> under the sun<WH08121>?<CM>

<FI> One<Fi> generation<WH01755> passeth away<WH01980><WTH8802>, and <FI>another<Fi> generation<WH01755> cometh<WH0935><WTH8802><WTH8676><WH0935><WTH8804>: but the earth<WH0776> abideth<WH05975><WTH8802> for ever<WH05769>.

The sun<WH08121> also ariseth<WH02224><WTH8804>, and the sun<WH08121> goeth down<WH0935><WTH8804>, and hasteth<WH07602><WTH8802> to his place<WH04725> where he arose<WH02224><WTH8802>. <RF>hasteth: Heb. panteth<Rf>

The wind<WH07307> goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> toward the south<WH01864>, and turneth about<WH05437><WTH8802> unto the north<WH06828>; it whirleth about continually<WH01980><WTH8802>, and the wind<WH07307> returneth again<WH07725><WTH8804> according to his circuits<WH05439>.

All the rivers<WH05158> run<WH01980><WTH8802> into the sea<WH03220>; yet the sea<WH03220> <FI>is<Fi> not full<WH04392>; unto the place<WH04725> from whence the rivers<WH05158> come<WH01980><WTH8802>, thither they return<WH07725><WTH8802> again<WH03212><WTH8800>. <RF>return...: Heb. return to go<Rf>

All things<WH01697> <FI>are<Fi> full of labour<WH03023>; man<WH0376> cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> utter<WH01696><WTH8763> <FI>it<Fi> : the eye<WH05869> is not satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799> with seeing<WH07200><WTH8800>, nor the ear<WH0241> filled<WH04390><WTH8735> with hearing<WH08085><WTH8800>.<CM>

The thing that hath been, it <FI>is that<Fi> which shall be; and that which is done<WH06213><WTH8738> <FI>is<Fi> that which shall be done<WH06213><WTH8735>: and <FI>there is<Fi> no new<WH02319> <FI>thing<Fi> under the sun<WH08121>.

Is there<WH03426> <FI>any<Fi> thing<WH01697> whereof it may be said<WH0559><WTH8799>, See<WH07200><WTH8798>, this <FI>is<Fi> new<WH02319>? it hath been already<WH03528> of old time<WH05769>, which was before<WH06440> us.

<FI> There is<Fi> no remembrance<WH02146> of former<WH07223> <FI>things<Fi> ; neither shall there be <FI>any<Fi> remembrance<WH02146> of <FI>things<Fi> that are to come<WH0314> with <FI>those<Fi> that shall come after<WH0314>.<CM>
I the Preacher<WH06953> was king<WH04428> over Israel<WH03478> in Jerusalem<WH03389>.

And I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> my heart<WH03820> to seek<WH01875><WTH8800> and search out<WH08446><WTH8800> by wisdom<WH02451> concerning all <FI>things<Fi> that are done<WH06213><WTH8738> under heaven<WH08064>: this sore<WH07451> travail<WH06045> hath God<WH0430> given<WH05414><WTH8804> to the sons<WH01121> of man<WH0120> to be exercised<WH06031><WTH8800> therewith. <RF>to be...: or, to afflict them<Rf>
I have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> all the works<WH04639> that are done<WH06213><WTH8738> under the sun<WH08121>; and, behold, all <FI>is<Fi> vanity<WH01892> and vexation<WH07469> of spirit<WH07307>.

<FI> That which is<Fi> crooked<WH05791><WTH8794> cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> be made straight<WH08626><WTH8800>: and that which is wanting<WH02642> cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> be numbered<WH04487><WTH8736>. <RF>that which is wanting: Heb. defect<Rf>

I communed<WH01696><WTH8765> with mine own heart<WH03820>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Lo, I am come to great estate<WH01431><WTH8689>, and have gotten<WH03254><WTH8689> more wisdom<WH02451> than all <FI>they<Fi>  that have been before<WH06440> me in Jerusalem<WH03389>: yea, my heart<WH03820> had great<WH07235><WTH8687> experience<WH07200><WTH8804> of wisdom<WH02451> and knowledge<WH01847>. <RF>had...: Heb. had seen much<Rf>

And I gave<WH05414><WTH8799> my heart<WH03820> to know<WH03045><WTH8800> wisdom<WH02451>, and to know<WH03045><WTH8800> madness<WH01947> and folly<WH05531>: I perceived<WH03045><WTH8804> that this<WH01571> also is vexation<WH07475> of spirit<WH07307>.
For in much<WH07230> wisdom<WH02451> <FI>is<Fi> much<WH07230> grief<WH03708>: and he that increaseth<WH03254><WTH8686> knowledge<WH01847> increaseth<WH03254><WTH8686> sorrow<WH04341>.<CM>
